visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men stand in a well-lit indoor residential setting. An older man with grey hair and a grey t-shirt looks skeptical while a younger man with short black hair and a white t-shirt smiles excitedly and speaks to the camera. (2) The younger man is seen indoors wearing a white shirt and blue hakama-style pants, holding a silver katana. A flash effect transitions to an AI-generated portrait of him as a fierce samurai with a giant red moon background and stylized flames. (3) The younger man is filmed inside a car, gripping the steering wheel and screaming in panic. The scene cuts to a white car that has veered off a narrow path into a green rice field and overturned. Another AI-generated image shows him screaming while driving amidst green energy swirls. (4) Outside on a paved street, the man attempts to lift a black motor scooter but struggles, making a strained facial expression. He then swings a long blade through the air. An AI image depicts him in a red kimono holding a flaming sword. (5) In a living room, the two men sit at a table covered in cash and playing cards. The younger man holds a glowing white sword and a hand of cards, followed by an AI image of him in a card-themed samurai outfit.
